Seed._comment: Absolute path to a resume file imported automatically on first run, when the database is empty. Safe to remove after first run; upload more resumes from the dashboard afterwards.

Claude._comment: ApiKey is best left null here and set via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or `dotnet user-secrets set Claude:ApiKey <key>` instead of committing it to this file.

JobSources._comment: Adzuna (https://developer.adzuna.com) and JSearch/RapidAPI (https://rapidapi.com/letscrape-6bRBa3QguO5/api/jsearch) both need free API keys. Remotive and Arbeitnow need no key and work out of the box.
